ex.en: Do you subscribe to any magazines?
ex.zh: 你有訂閱什麼雜誌嗎？

ex.en: What newspaper do you subscribe to?
ex.zh: 你訂閱哪一份報紙？

ex.en: Starting next month, I'm not subscribing to a newspaper.
ex.zh: 從下個月開始，我不訂報紙了。

ex.en: Subscribe to our channel for more videos.
ex.zh: 訂閱我們的頻道，看更多影片。

ex.en: The company uses sustainable materials in its products.
ex.zh: 這家公司在產品中使用永續材料。

ex.en: We need a more sustainable way of living.
ex.zh: 我們需要更永續的生活方式。

ex.en: All subscriptions must be paid before the end of this year.
ex.zh: 所有訂閱費都必須在今年底前繳清。

ex.en: The subscription service is available for a fixed monthly fee with a one-month free trial.
ex.zh: 這項訂閱服務採固定月費，並提供一個月免費試用。

ex.en: I cancelled my magazine subscription last month.
ex.zh: 我上個月取消了雜誌訂閱。

ex.en: Please go to the supermarket to buy some fruit.
ex.zh: 請你去超市買些水果回來。

ex.en: There is a big supermarket in my neighborhood.
ex.zh: 我家附近有一間大超市。

ex.en: It being Sunday, the supermarket was very crowded.
ex.zh: 因為是星期天，超市非常擁擠。

ex.en: The deadline for submission is Friday.
ex.zh: 提交期限是星期五。

ex.en: We received over 200 submissions for the contest.
ex.zh: 我們收到兩百多件參賽作品。

ex.en: We have the alternative of death and submission.
ex.zh: 我們只能在死亡和屈服之間二選一。

ex.en: They were forced into submission.
ex.zh: 他們被迫屈服。

ex.en: She supervises a team of ten engineers.
ex.zh: 她管理一個由十位工程師組成的團隊。

ex.en: Children must be supervised at the pool.
ex.zh: 孩子在泳池時必須有人看管。

ex.en: Who will supervise the project while you're away?
ex.zh: 你不在的時候誰負責監督這個專案？

ex.en: We booked a suite with an ocean view.
ex.zh: 我們訂了一間海景套房。

ex.en: The hotel upgraded us to a suite for free.
ex.zh: 飯店免費幫我們升級成套房。

ex.en: Our office uses the Microsoft Office suite.
ex.zh: 我們辦公室使用 Microsoft Office 套裝軟體。

ex.en: This software suite includes design and editing tools.
ex.zh: 這套軟體套件包含設計和編輯工具。

ex.en: The magazine has over 10,000 subscribers.
ex.zh: 這本雜誌有超過一萬名訂戶。

ex.en: Our channel just reached one million subscribers.
ex.zh: 我們的頻道剛突破一百萬訂閱。

ex.en: This carpet is superior to that one in quality.
ex.zh: 這塊地毯的品質比那塊好得多。

ex.en: He is superior to me in English.
ex.zh: 他的英文比我好。

ex.en: He is superior to his opponents in all respects.
ex.zh: 他在各方面都勝過對手。

ex.en: Be respectful to your superiors, if you have any.
ex.zh: 如果你有上司，要尊重他們。

ex.en: You should report this problem to your superior.
ex.zh: 你應該把這個問題報告給你的上司。

ex.en: The company is located in the suburbs of Boston.
ex.zh: 這家公司位於波士頓的郊區。

ex.en: A car is a must for life in the suburbs.
ex.zh: 住在郊區的話，汽車是必需品。

ex.en: He lives in the suburbs of Tokyo.
ex.zh: 他住在東京郊區。

ex.en: We went surfing in Kenting last summer.
ex.zh: 我們去年夏天去墾丁衝浪。

ex.en: Do you know how to surf?
ex.zh: 你會衝浪嗎？

ex.en: She spends way too much time surfing the web.
ex.zh: 她花太多時間上網了。

ex.en: I surfed the internet for hours last night.
ex.zh: 我昨晚上網上了好幾個小時。

ex.en: The lake was gleaming in the bright sunshine.
ex.zh: 湖面在燦爛的陽光下閃閃發亮。

ex.en: Let's sit outside and enjoy the sunshine.
ex.zh: 我們坐在外面曬曬太陽吧。

ex.en: Subtract three from eight and you get five.
ex.zh: 八減三等於五。

ex.en: Subtract two from ten and you have eight.
ex.zh: 十減二等於八。

ex.en: Subtract the discount from the total price.
ex.zh: 從總價中扣掉折扣。

ex.en: Sales have increased substantially this year.
ex.zh: 今年銷售大幅成長。

ex.en: The new system substantially reduces costs.
ex.zh: 新系統大幅降低了成本。

ex.en: The two reports are substantially the same.
ex.zh: 這兩份報告大致相同。

ex.en: The plan remains substantially unchanged.
ex.zh: 計畫基本上沒有改變。

ex.en: They sued the government for damages.
ex.zh: 他們控告政府，要求損害賠償。

ex.en: The customer threatened to sue the company.
ex.zh: 那位顧客揚言要告這家公司。

ex.en: She sued her former employer for unfair dismissal.
ex.zh: 她控告前雇主不當解僱。

ex.en: The hotel offers superb views of the ocean.
ex.zh: 這家飯店可以欣賞絕佳的海景。

ex.en: The food at the wedding was superb.
ex.zh: 婚宴上的菜色非常棒。

ex.en: The city should subsidize small businesses in industries with large overhead costs.
ex.zh: 市政府應該補助那些營運成本龐大產業中的小型企業。

ex.en: The government subsidizes public transportation.
ex.zh: 政府補貼大眾運輸。

ex.en: The company subsidizes employees' gym memberships.
ex.zh: 公司補助員工的健身房會費。

ex.en: Did you notice any suspicious places?
ex.zh: 你有注意到任何可疑的地方嗎？

ex.en: This statement is actually kind of suspicious.
ex.zh: 這種說法其實有點可疑。

ex.en: Please report any suspicious packages to staff.
ex.zh: 如果發現可疑包裹，請通報工作人員。

suspicious.zh: 懷疑的、起疑心的（be suspicious of）

ex.en: The police were suspicious of his movements.
ex.zh: 警方對他的行蹤起了疑心。

ex.en: The police are suspicious of my alibi.
ex.zh: 警方懷疑我的不在場證明。

ex.en: My manager was suspicious of the low price.
ex.zh: 我的經理對這麼低的價格感到懷疑。

ex.en: Put on some sunscreen.
ex.zh: 擦點防曬乳吧。

ex.en: Don't forget to bring sunscreen to the beach.
ex.zh: 去海邊別忘了帶防曬乳。

ex.en: The company has subsidiaries in five countries.
ex.zh: 這家公司在五個國家設有子公司。

ex.en: She works for a subsidiary of a Japanese firm.
ex.zh: 她在一家日本公司的子公司上班。

ex.en: This is a subsidiary issue, so let's focus on the main one.
ex.zh: 這是次要問題，我們先專注在主要問題上。

ex.en: The department plays a subsidiary role.
ex.zh: 這個部門扮演輔助的角色。

ex.en: We had a sub today because our teacher was sick.
ex.zh: 老師生病了，所以今天有代課老師。

ex.en: The coach brought on a sub in the second half.
ex.zh: 教練在下半場換上一名替補球員。

ex.en: Can I sub salad for fries?
ex.zh: 我可以把薯條換成沙拉嗎？

ex.en: Tom subbed for me at the meeting.
ex.zh: 湯姆代替我去開會。

ex.en: I'll grab a turkey sub for lunch.
ex.zh: 我午餐要買個火雞肉潛艇堡。

ex.en: This shop makes the best subs in town.
ex.zh: 這家店的潛艇堡是全城最好吃的。

ex.en: The summit of Mt. Fuji was covered in snow.
ex.zh: 富士山頂覆蓋著白雪。

ex.en: Who first reached the summit of Mt. Everest?
ex.zh: 誰最先登上聖母峰頂？

ex.en: The air is thin at the summit.
ex.zh: 山頂的空氣很稀薄。

ex.en: World leaders will meet at the summit next week.
ex.zh: 各國領袖下週將在高峰會上會面。

ex.en: The company hosted a summit on climate technology.
ex.zh: 公司主辦了一場氣候科技高峰會。

ex.en: The board has chosen a successor to the CEO.
ex.zh: 董事會已選出執行長的接班人。

ex.en: I will train my successor before I leave.
ex.zh: 我離職前會訓練我的接任者。

ex.en: Tom tried to suppress a smile.
ex.zh: 湯姆努力忍住不笑。

ex.en: Heathers help to suppress weeds in your garden.
ex.zh: 石楠有助於抑制花園裡的雜草。

ex.en: This medicine can suppress your appetite.
ex.zh: 這種藥會抑制食慾。

ex.en: Is France trying to suppress Algeria's development?
ex.zh: 法國是在試圖壓制阿爾及利亞的發展嗎？

ex.en: The company tried to suppress the bad news.
ex.zh: 公司試圖封鎖壞消息。

ex.en: According to the newspaper, he committed suicide.
ex.zh: 據報導，他自殺了。

ex.en: The popular singer committed suicide.
ex.zh: 那位知名歌手自殺了。

ex.en: Raising prices now would be commercial suicide.
ex.zh: 現在漲價等於是商業自殺。

ex.en: Quitting without a plan is career suicide.
ex.zh: 沒計畫就辭職等於斷送職涯。

ex.en: The news confirmed my suspicions.
ex.zh: 這則消息證實了我的懷疑。

ex.en: My suspicions were unfounded.
ex.zh: 我的懷疑毫無根據。

ex.en: Suspicion is destructive of friendship.
ex.zh: 猜疑會破壞友誼。

ex.en: He was under suspicion of being a spy.
ex.zh: 他被懷疑是間諜。

ex.en: He was arrested on suspicion of fraud.
ex.zh: 他因涉嫌詐欺被逮捕。

ex.en: Sami had no choice but to surrender.
ex.zh: 薩米別無選擇，只能投降。

ex.en: I would rather die than surrender.
ex.zh: 我寧死也不投降。

ex.en: The garrison was forced to surrender.
ex.zh: 駐軍被迫投降。

ex.en: Passengers must surrender their tickets at the gate.
ex.zh: 乘客必須在入口交出票券。

ex.en: He refused to surrender control of the company.
ex.zh: 他拒絕交出公司的控制權。

ex.en: The restaurant is supposedly the best in town.
ex.zh: 據說這家餐廳是城裡最好的。

ex.en: This printer is supposedly easy to use, but I can't get it to work.
ex.zh: 這台印表機照理說很好用，但我就是弄不好。

ex.en: Tom is supposedly on vacation this week.
ex.zh: 湯姆這週應該是在休假。

ex.en: The room is not sufficiently large for the meeting.
ex.zh: 這個房間不夠大，容納不了這場會議。

ex.en: Make sure the meat is sufficiently cooked.
ex.zh: 要確定肉有充分煮熟。

ex.en: Has the plan been sufficiently tested?
ex.zh: 這個方案經過充分測試了嗎？

ex.en: New employees work under the supervision of a senior colleague.
ex.zh: 新進員工在資深同事的督導下工作。

ex.en: Children should not swim without supervision.
ex.zh: 小孩不應該在沒人看顧的情況下游泳。

ex.en: Substitutions are not allowed on the set menu.
ex.zh: 套餐內容不能更換。

ex.en: The recipe allows the substitution of olive oil for butter.
ex.zh: 這道食譜可以用橄欖油代替奶油。

ex.en: I'm super hungry.
ex.zh: 我超餓的。

ex.en: I only buy super soft toilet paper.
ex.zh: 我只買超柔軟的衛生紙。

ex.en: Po-lin ran into his ex at the night market yesterday. It was super awkward.
ex.zh: 柏霖昨天在夜市遇到前女友，尷尬到不行。

ex.en: We had a super time at the party.
ex.zh: 我們在派對上玩得超開心。

ex.en: That's a super idea!
ex.zh: 那真是個超棒的點子！

ex.en: The subprime mortgage crisis began in 2007.
ex.zh: 次級房貸危機始於 2007 年。

ex.en: Subprime loans are risky for lenders.
ex.zh: 次級貸款對放款人來說風險很高。

ex.en: His writing is very subjective.
ex.zh: 他的文章寫得很主觀。

ex.en: Taste in music is very subjective.
ex.zh: 對音樂的喜好是很主觀的。

ex.en: It rained five successive days.
ex.zh: 雨連續下了五天。

ex.en: The company has reported losses for three successive years.
ex.zh: 這家公司已連續三年虧損。

ex.en: Successive governments have failed to solve the problem.
ex.zh: 歷屆政府都沒能解決這個問題。

ex.en: We had a succession of problems with the new software.
ex.zh: 新軟體接二連三出問題。

ex.en: She won three titles in succession.
ex.zh: 她連續拿下三座冠軍。

ex.en: The board is discussing succession planning.
ex.zh: 董事會正在討論接班計畫。

ex.en: The CEO's succession was announced last week.
ex.zh: 執行長的接班人選上週公布了。

subtle.zh: 細微的、微妙的、不明顯的

ex.en: There are subtle differences between the two pictures.
ex.zh: 這兩張圖片之間有細微的差異。

ex.en: She gave me a subtle hint.
ex.zh: 她給了我一個委婉的暗示。

ex.en: The changes to the logo are subtle.
ex.zh: 標誌的改變很細微。

ex.en: Please refer to subsection 3.2 of the contract.
ex.zh: 請參閱合約第 3.2 小節。

ex.en: Each chapter is divided into several subsections.
ex.zh: 每一章都分成幾個小節。

ex.en: The company is committed to sustainability.
ex.zh: 這家公司致力於永續經營。

ex.en: Sustainability is a key part of our business strategy.
ex.zh: 永續是我們商業策略的重要一環。

ex.en: She has five years of supervisory experience.
ex.zh: 她有五年的管理經驗。

ex.en: He was promoted to a supervisory role.
ex.zh: 他被升為管理職。

ex.en: Tom didn't notice the surveillance camera.
ex.zh: 湯姆沒有注意到監視器。

ex.en: The building is under 24-hour video surveillance.
ex.zh: 這棟大樓有二十四小時的錄影監控。

ex.en: Why do you need to read such a book?
ex.zh: 你為什麼要讀這種書？

ex.en: Such a plan will give rise to many problems.
ex.zh: 這樣的計畫會引發很多問題。

such.zh: 如此、那麼（such a + 形容詞 + 名詞）

ex.en: I can't afford to buy such an expensive car.
ex.zh: 我買不起這麼貴的車。

ex.en: It was such a nice day.
ex.zh: 那天天氣真好。

ex.en: We sell fruit such as apples and bananas.
ex.zh: 我們賣蘋果、香蕉等水果。

ex.en: Big cities such as Taipei are expensive to live in.
ex.zh: 像台北這樣的大城市生活費很高。

ex.en: I am not sure how to pronounce the word.
ex.zh: 我不太確定這個字怎麼發音。

ex.en: I was sure I had never seen her before.
ex.zh: 我確定我以前沒見過她。

ex.en: I am sure that he is an honest man.
ex.zh: 我確信他是個誠實的人。

ex.en: Sure, I'd be happy to help.
ex.zh: 當然，我很樂意幫忙。

ex.en: Sure, you can use my laptop.
ex.zh: 好啊，你可以用我的筆電。

ex.en: Please make sure the door is locked.
ex.zh: 請確認門有鎖好。

ex.en: Make sure you save your work.
ex.zh: 記得一定要存檔。

ex.en: Where do you suppose you'll spend your vacation?
ex.zh: 你想你會去哪裡度假？

ex.en: I could tell Tom the truth, I suppose.
ex.zh: 我想我可以告訴湯姆實話。

ex.en: I suppose you're right.
ex.zh: 我想你說得對。

ex.en: I have done everything I was supposed to do.
ex.zh: 我該做的事都做了。

ex.en: Tom isn't doing what he's supposed to be doing.
ex.zh: 湯姆沒有在做他該做的事。

ex.en: Supposing you had one million yen, what would you do with it?
ex.zh: 假如你有一百萬日圓，你會拿來做什麼？

ex.en: Suppose the flight is canceled. What will we do?
ex.zh: 假設班機取消了，我們該怎麼辦？

ex.en: To my surprise, there were no people in the village.
ex.zh: 令人意外的是，村子裡一個人也沒有。

ex.en: To my surprise, he easily came up with a plan.
ex.zh: 令我驚訝的是，他輕易就想出了一個計畫。

surprise.zh: 使驚訝（be surprised 感到驚訝）

ex.en: I'm surprised that you don't know about their marriage.
ex.zh: 我很驚訝你竟然不知道他們結婚了。

ex.en: I'm surprised you agreed to have lunch with me.
ex.zh: 我很意外你願意和我一起吃午餐。

ex.en: Japan is full of surprises!
ex.zh: 日本處處充滿驚喜！

ex.en: We're planning a surprise party for Amy.
ex.zh: 我們正在為艾咪籌備驚喜派對。

ex.en: What a nice surprise!
ex.zh: 真是個驚喜！

ex.en: Honesty was the most important factor in his success.
ex.zh: 誠實是他成功最重要的因素。

ex.en: He was happy at the news of her success.
ex.zh: 聽到她成功的消息，他很高興。

ex.en: Please accept my sincere congratulations on your success today.
ex.zh: 對您今天的成功，請接受我最誠摯的祝賀。

ex.en: Brazil supplies the world with coffee beans of quality.
ex.zh: 巴西向全世界供應優質咖啡豆。

ex.en: This dam supplies us with water and electricity.
ex.zh: 這座水壩為我們提供水和電。

ex.en: We have supplied the villagers with food.
ex.zh: 我們提供食物給村民。

ex.en: The supply of fresh water is limited.
ex.zh: 淡水的供應有限。

ex.en: Prices rise when supply is low.
ex.zh: 供給不足時價格就會上漲。

ex.en: We need to order more office supplies.
ex.zh: 我們需要再訂一些辦公用品。

ex.en: Please bring your own art supplies.
ex.zh: 請自備美術用品。

ex.en: The number of people suffering from heart disease has increased.
ex.zh: 罹患心臟病的人數增加了。

ex.en: Do you suffer from diseases that require medication?
ex.zh: 您是否患有需要服藥的疾病？

ex.en: Many people are suffering from hunger around the world.
ex.zh: 世界上許多人正在挨餓。

ex.en: She looks happy, but deep down, she suffers.
ex.zh: 她看起來很幸福，但內心深處很痛苦。

ex.en: The company suffered heavy losses last year.
ex.zh: 公司去年遭受重大虧損。

ex.en: Their common aim was to make the project successful.
ex.zh: 他們共同的目標是讓這個專案成功。

ex.en: Tom seems to be a fairly successful businessman.
ex.zh: 湯姆看起來是個相當成功的商人。

ex.en: On the whole, the event was successful.
ex.zh: 整體而言，這場活動很成功。

ex.en: Jack suddenly stopped talking when Mary entered the room.
ex.zh: 瑪麗一走進房間，傑克就突然不說話了。

ex.en: The bus stopped suddenly in the middle of the street.
ex.zh: 公車突然在路中間停了下來。

ex.en: A boat suddenly appeared out of the mist.
ex.zh: 一艘船突然從霧中出現。

ex.en: Father always has the tailor make his suits.
ex.zh: 父親的西裝總是請這位裁縫訂做。

ex.en: Tom only wears a suit on special occasions.
ex.zh: 湯姆只在特殊場合穿西裝。

ex.en: You should wear a suit to the job interview.
ex.zh: 去面試應該穿西裝。

ex.en: I don't think John is suited for the job.
ex.zh: 我不覺得約翰適合這份工作。

ex.en: This work is not suited to young girls.
ex.zh: 這份工作不適合年輕女孩。

ex.en: I'll see you whenever it suits you.
ex.zh: 你什麼時候方便，我們就什麼時候見面。

ex.en: The customer filed a suit against the company.
ex.zh: 那位顧客對公司提起訴訟。

ex.en: The company settled the suit out of court.
ex.zh: 公司在庭外和解了這起訴訟。

ex.en: About one third of the earth's surface is land.
ex.zh: 地球表面大約三分之一是陸地。

ex.en: A light breeze stirred the surface of the lake.
ex.zh: 微風吹動湖面。

ex.en: The surface of the object is fairly rough.
ex.zh: 這個物體的表面相當粗糙。

ex.en: The fugitive surfaced in a small town fifty miles from here but then disappeared again.
ex.zh: 那名逃犯在離這裡五十英里的小鎮現身後，又消失了。

ex.en: New problems surfaced during the test.
ex.zh: 測試期間出現了新的問題。

ex.en: Your interpretation is based merely on the surface meaning.
ex.zh: 你的理解只是根據字面意思。

ex.en: The differences are only surface details.
ex.zh: 這些差異只是表面細節。

ex.en: The garden was surrounded by a wooden fence.
ex.zh: 花園四周圍著木柵欄。

ex.en: He was surrounded by a throng of reporters.
ex.zh: 他被一大群記者包圍。

ex.en: Japan is a country surrounded by the sea on all sides.
ex.zh: 日本是四面環海的國家。

ex.en: The surrounding area was very quiet.
ex.zh: 周圍地區非常安靜。

ex.en: I've been to the area surrounding Shanghai.
ex.zh: 我去過上海周邊地區。

ex.en: Only 3 out of the 98 passengers survived.
ex.zh: 98 名乘客中只有 3 人生還。

ex.en: If it weren't for water, humans wouldn't survive.
ex.zh: 沒有水的話，人類就活不下去。

ex.en: Only a few old buildings survived the earthquake.
ex.zh: 只有少數老建築在地震中倖存。

ex.en: Small businesses will have to tighten their belts to survive.
ex.zh: 小企業得勒緊褲帶才能撐下去。

ex.en: I can't survive without air conditioning in the summer.
ex.zh: 夏天沒有冷氣我活不下去。

ex.en: The company survived the financial crisis.
ex.zh: 這家公司撐過了金融危機。

ex.en: Tom refused to even listen to my suggestions.
ex.zh: 湯姆連聽都不肯聽我的建議。

ex.en: Her suggestion seems to have been turned down.
ex.zh: 她的建議好像被否決了。

ex.en: Why don't you give me a few suggestions?
ex.zh: 你何不給我一些建議？

ex.en: The sun rises earlier in summer than in winter.
ex.zh: 太陽在夏天比冬天早升起。

ex.en: Cover your head when you are in the sun.
ex.zh: 在大太陽底下要把頭遮住。

ex.en: We should sometimes expose our bodies to the sun.
ex.zh: 我們偶爾應該出去曬曬太陽。

ex.en: She had only a small sum of money.
ex.zh: 她當時只有一點點錢。

ex.en: The sum came to over 20,000 yen.
ex.zh: 總金額超過了兩萬日圓。

ex.en: The company paid a large sum for the land.
ex.zh: 公司花了一大筆錢買下那塊地。

ex.en: The sum of 5 and 3 is 8.
ex.zh: 五加三的和是八。

ex.en: The sum of two plus three plus four is nine.
ex.zh: 二加三加四的總和是九。

ex.en: His thesis summed up the new achievements made in computers, artificial satellites and rockets.
ex.zh: 他的論文總結了電腦、人造衛星和火箭方面的新成就。

ex.en: To sum up, the project was a success.
ex.zh: 總而言之，這個專案很成功。

ex.en: He suspects me of telling a lie.
ex.zh: 他懷疑我說謊。

ex.en: I suspect Tom knows what he's supposed to do.
ex.zh: 我猜湯姆知道自己該做什麼。

ex.en: I suspect that the printer is broken again.
ex.zh: 我猜印表機又壞了。

ex.en: The police arrested two suspects.
ex.zh: 警方逮捕了兩名嫌犯。

ex.en: The suspect was seen leaving the bank.
ex.zh: 有人看到嫌犯離開銀行。

ex.en: You must work hard if you want to succeed.
ex.zh: 如果你想成功，就必須努力。

ex.en: She succeeded in getting him to tell the truth.
ex.zh: 她成功讓他說出了真相。

ex.en: We believe he will succeed, for he has talent.
ex.zh: 他很有才能，我們相信他會成功。

ex.en: She will succeed Mr. Lin as CEO next year.
ex.zh: 她明年將接替林先生擔任執行長。

ex.en: Who succeeded him as manager?
ex.zh: 誰接替他當經理？

ex.en: These scissors are suitable for left and right-handed people.
ex.zh: 這把剪刀左右手都適用。

ex.en: Fill in the blanks with suitable words.
ex.zh: 請在空格中填入適當的字詞。

ex.en: We are still looking for a suitable venue for the event.
ex.zh: 我們還在找適合辦活動的場地。

surely.zh: 一定、想必；（表示驚訝）難道

ex.en: Among the five of us, he's surely the one who can speak the most languages.
ex.zh: 我們五個人之中，他一定是會說最多種語言的。

ex.en: Surely you don't believe him?
ex.zh: 你該不會相信他吧？

surely.zh: slowly but surely：緩慢但穩定地

ex.en: Slowly but surely, the business is growing.
ex.zh: 生意雖然成長得慢，但很穩定。

ex.en: My English is improving slowly but surely.
ex.zh: 我的英文雖然進步得慢，但一步步在進步。

ex.en: The company made a substantial profit this year.
ex.zh: 公司今年獲利可觀。

ex.en: We received a substantial number of complaints.
ex.zh: 我們收到了大量的客訴。

ex.en: There is no substantial difference between the two plans.
ex.zh: 這兩個計畫沒有實質上的差異。

ex.en: The report contains substantial changes.
ex.zh: 這份報告有重大的修改。

ex.en: We have sufficient evidence to prove this hypothesis.
ex.zh: 我們有充分的證據證明這個假設。

ex.en: The room lighting is sufficient.
ex.zh: 房間的光線很充足。

ex.en: I haven't yet collected sufficient materials to write a book.
ex.zh: 我還沒蒐集到足夠的資料來寫一本書。

ex.en: There was a sudden change in her tone.
ex.zh: 她的語氣突然變了。

ex.en: I was surprised at the news of his sudden death.
ex.zh: 聽到他猝逝的消息，我很驚訝。

ex.en: All of a sudden, she began to laugh.
ex.zh: 她突然笑了起來。

ex.en: All of a sudden the sky became dark.
ex.zh: 天空突然暗了下來。

supporter.zh: 支持者；（球隊的）支持者、球迷

ex.en: We are looking for supporters.
ex.zh: 我們正在尋找支持者。

ex.en: She is a strong supporter of the new policy.
ex.zh: 她大力支持這項新政策。

ex.en: Thousands of supporters attended the match.
ex.zh: 數千名球迷到場觀賽。

ex.en: The substance is light enough to float on the water.
ex.zh: 這種物質很輕，可以浮在水面上。

ex.en: The mixture of these substances is dangerous.
ex.zh: 把這些物質混在一起很危險。

ex.en: Water and ice are the same substance in different forms.
ex.zh: 水和冰是同一種物質的不同形態。

ex.en: The speech was long but lacked substance.
ex.zh: 這場演講很長，但缺乏實質內容。

ex.en: There is no substance to these rumors.
ex.zh: 這些傳言毫無根據。

ex.en: I am not used to drinking coffee without sugar.
ex.zh: 我不習慣喝不加糖的咖啡。

ex.en: How much sugar should I put in your coffee?
ex.zh: 你的咖啡要加多少糖？

ex.en: We need flour, sugar and eggs to make this cake.
ex.zh: 做這個蛋糕需要麵粉、砂糖和雞蛋。

ex.en: Subsequent meetings will be held online.
ex.zh: 之後的會議將在線上舉行。

ex.en: The problem was fixed in a subsequent update.
ex.zh: 這個問題在後續的更新中修正了。

ex.en: The company cannot sustain such rapid growth.
ex.zh: 公司無法維持如此快速的成長。

ex.en: We need more funding to sustain the project.
ex.zh: 我們需要更多資金來維持這個專案。

ex.en: We sustained significant losses.
ex.zh: 我們蒙受了重大損失。

ex.en: Tom sustained serious burns and had to go to the hospital.
ex.zh: 湯姆嚴重燒傷，必須去醫院。

ex.en: I developed a tumor in my stomach, which required surgery.
ex.zh: 我胃裡長了腫瘤，必須動手術。

ex.en: Do I need surgery?
ex.zh: 我需要做手術嗎？

ex.en: Cosmetic surgery is not covered by most insurance plans.
ex.zh: 大部分保險方案都不給付整形手術。

ex.en: Air pollution will be a threat to our survival.
ex.zh: 空氣汙染將會威脅我們的生存。

ex.en: Food, clothing and shelter are the foundations of survival.
ex.zh: 衣食住是生存的基礎。

ex.en: This medicine will increase the survival rate of the patients.
ex.zh: 這種藥會提高病人的存活率。

ex.en: She successfully got him to tell the truth.
ex.zh: 她成功讓他說出了實話。

ex.en: He was extremely happy at having successfully solved the problem.
ex.zh: 他成功解決了這個問題，非常高興。

ex.en: Few governments can manage the economy successfully.
ex.zh: 能成功管理好經濟的政府不多。

ex.en: The test was surprisingly easy.
ex.zh: 這次考試出乎意料地簡單。

ex.en: Surprisingly, nobody complained about the price.
ex.zh: 令人意外的是，沒有人抱怨價格。

ex.en: The hotel was surprisingly cheap.
ex.zh: 這家飯店意外地便宜。

substitute.zh: 代替品；代替者（如代課老師、替補）

ex.en: There is no substitute for hard work.
ex.zh: 努力是無可取代的。

ex.en: Our teacher was sick, so we had a substitute today.
ex.zh: 我們老師生病了，所以今天有代課老師。

ex.en: She substituted margarine for butter.
ex.zh: 她用人造奶油代替奶油。

ex.en: He substituted for his father.
ex.zh: 他接替了他父親的位置。

ex.en: You can substitute honey for sugar in this recipe.
ex.zh: 這道食譜可以用蜂蜜代替糖。

ex.en: From now on, you should exercise regularly. I bought some health supplements for you to try.
ex.zh: 以後要經常運動。我買了一些保健食品給你試試看。

ex.en: Many people take vitamin supplements every day.
ex.zh: 很多人每天吃維他命補充品。

ex.en: He supplements his income by teaching English at night.
ex.zh: 他晚上教英文來貼補收入。

ex.en: You can supplement your diet with fruit and nuts.
ex.zh: 你可以用水果和堅果來補充飲食。

ex.en: The newspaper publishes a travel supplement on Sundays.
ex.zh: 這份報紙每週日出旅遊特刊。

ex.en: See the supplement at the end of the report for details.
ex.zh: 詳細內容請見報告末尾的附錄。

ex.en: Summarize the contents in 60 English words.
ex.zh: 請用六十個英文字摘要內容。

ex.en: Could you summarize the main points of the meeting?
ex.zh: 你能總結一下會議重點嗎？

ex.en: To summarize, sales rose by ten percent this year.
ex.zh: 總結來說，今年銷售額成長了一成。

ex.en: The meeting was subsequently canceled.
ex.zh: 那場會議後來被取消了。

ex.en: He joined the company in 2015 and subsequently became a manager.
ex.zh: 他 2015 年進公司，後來升為經理。

ex.en: Suspend the game.
ex.zh: 暫停比賽。

ex.en: The airline suspended all flights because of the typhoon.
ex.zh: 航空公司因颱風暫停所有航班。

ex.en: Production was suspended for two weeks.
ex.zh: 生產暫停了兩週。

ex.en: He was suspended from school for a week.
ex.zh: 他被停學一週。

ex.en: The employee was suspended without pay.
ex.zh: 那名員工被無薪停職。

ex.en: The lamp was suspended from the branch of a tree.
ex.zh: 燈掛在樹枝上。

ex.en: The earth is just a sphere suspended in space.
ex.zh: 地球只是一個懸浮在太空中的球體。

ex.en: Only a small subset of users reported the bug.
ex.zh: 只有一小部分使用者回報了這個錯誤。

ex.en: This data is a subset of the full survey.
ex.zh: 這些資料是完整調查的一部分。

ex.en: The chips are built on a silicon substrate.
ex.zh: 這些晶片是做在矽基板上的。

ex.en: Mushrooms grow on a substrate of straw.
ex.zh: 蘑菇長在稻草做成的基質上。

ex.en: My father is an expert surgeon.
ex.zh: 我爸爸是一位技術精湛的外科醫生。

ex.en: He's an excellent brain surgeon.
ex.zh: 他是一位優秀的腦外科醫生。

ex.en: The surgeon explained the operation to the patient.
ex.zh: 外科醫生向病人說明手術內容。

ex.en: The patient needs surgical treatment.
ex.zh: 病人需要手術治療。

ex.en: Doctors wear surgical masks during operations.
ex.zh: 醫生在手術時戴外科口罩。

ex.en: She was susceptible to colds.
ex.zh: 她很容易感冒。

ex.en: Older computers are more susceptible to viruses.
ex.zh: 舊電腦比較容易中毒。

ex.en: I suggested that we should stay there another day.
ex.zh: 我提議我們在那裡再待一天。

ex.en: I suggest you turn around and go back home.
ex.zh: 我建議你轉身回家。

ex.en: I suggested that we should go to the movies.
ex.zh: 我提議我們應該去看電影。

ex.en: Are you suggesting that I am too young?
ex.zh: 您是在暗示我太年輕嗎？

ex.en: His accent suggests he is a foreigner.
ex.zh: 他的口音顯示他是外國人。

ex.en: It all depends on whether they will support us.
ex.zh: 這一切都要看他們支不支持我們。

ex.en: My family has always supported my decisions.
ex.zh: 我的家人一直都支持我的決定。

ex.en: I worked hard in order to support my family.
ex.zh: 我努力工作養家。

ex.en: She supports her parents with her salary.
ex.zh: 她用自己的薪水奉養父母。

ex.en: I'd like a phone that supports fast charging.
ex.zh: 我想要支援快充的手機。

ex.en: Subscribers can play across phones, tablets, and computers, with certain games supporting multiplayer access and cloud sync.
ex.zh: 訂閱後可以在手機、平板和電腦上遊玩，部分遊戲支援多人連線和雲端同步。

ex.en: The steak was tender and succulent.
ex.zh: 牛排又嫩又多汁。

ex.en: These peaches are sweet and succulent.
ex.zh: 這些水蜜桃又甜又多汁。

ex.en: She keeps several succulents on her desk.
ex.zh: 她桌上放了好幾盆多肉植物。

ex.en: Succulents don't need much water.
ex.zh: 多肉植物不太需要澆水。

ex.en: A warm, sunny day is ideal for a picnic.
ex.zh: 溫暖的晴天最適合野餐。

ex.en: I also hope for sunny weather at the weekend.
ex.zh: 我也希望週末是晴天。

ex.en: Tomorrow will be a sunny day, and very hot.
ex.zh: 明天是晴天，而且會很熱。

ex.en: She has a sunny personality.
ex.zh: 她個性很開朗。

ex.en: He always greets us with a sunny smile.
ex.zh: 他總是帶著燦爛的笑容跟我們打招呼。

ex.en: Every year, the summers get hotter and the winters get colder.
ex.zh: 夏天一年比一年熱，冬天一年比一年冷。

ex.en: My friend George is coming to Japan this summer.
ex.zh: 我朋友George今年夏天要來日本。

ex.en: Taipei's summers are extremely hot and humid!
ex.zh: 台北的夏天又熱又潮濕！

ex.en: She turned down the subsidy that I offered.
ex.zh: 她拒絕了我提供的補助。

ex.en: Farmers receive government subsidies.
ex.zh: 農民會領取政府補貼。

ex.en: The builder hired a subcontractor for the electrical work.
ex.zh: 營造商把電力工程轉包給下包廠商。

ex.en: Subcontractors must follow our safety rules.
ex.zh: 下包廠商必須遵守我們的安全規定。

ex.en: A recent survey shows that the number of smokers is decreasing.
ex.zh: 最近的一項調查顯示吸菸的人數減少了。

ex.en: According to the latest survey, 99% of employees want a free iPad.
ex.zh: 根據最新調查，99% 的員工想要一台免費的 iPad。

ex.en: The results of the Chinese Academy of Sciences' survey are like this.
ex.zh: 中國科學院的調查結果是這樣的。

ex.en: We surveyed 1,000 customers about our service.
ex.zh: 我們針對服務品質調查了一千位顧客。

ex.en: Engineers surveyed the land before building the road.
ex.zh: 工程師在開路前先測量了土地。

ex.en: Edit your work better before you submit it, it's sloppy.
ex.zh: 交出去之前請好好檢查，這裡很粗糙。

ex.en: Your order has been submitted.
ex.zh: 您的訂單已送出。

ex.en: The due date for submitting the application is this Friday.
ex.zh: 申請截止日是這個星期五。

ex.en: He submits to authority.
ex.zh: 他屈服於權威。

ex.en: They refused to submit to the new rules.
ex.zh: 他們拒絕服從新規定。

ex.en: There is an urgent need for medical supplies.
ex.zh: 現在急需醫療用品。

ex.en: There's an urgent need for medical supplies.
ex.zh: 醫療用品嚴重不足。

ex.en: We're running out of office supplies.
ex.zh: 我們的辦公用品快用完了。

ex.en: Brazil supplies the world with coffee beans of quality.
ex.zh: 巴西供應全世界優質的咖啡豆。

ex.en: This dam supplies us with water and electricity.
ex.zh: 這座水壩供應我們用水和電力。

ex.en: This school supplies textbooks to its students.
ex.zh: 這所學校為學生提供教科書。

ex.en: The country has a trade surplus with Europe.
ex.zh: 這個國家對歐洲有貿易順差。

ex.en: There is a surplus of teachers in some areas.
ex.zh: 有些地區的教師人數過剩。

ex.en: We donated the surplus food to a shelter.
ex.zh: 我們把多餘的食物捐給了收容所。

ex.en: The factory sold its surplus equipment.
ex.zh: 工廠把多餘的設備賣掉了。

ex.en: The policy allows suspension during an investigation.
ex.zh: 這項政策允許在調查期間暫時停職。

ex.en: The service suspension will last two hours.
ex.zh: 服務將暫停兩小時。

ex.en: We want to develop a new supply chain with a supplier from Algeria.
ex.zh: 我們想和阿爾及利亞的供應商建立新的供應鏈。

ex.en: The storm disrupted the company's supply chain.
ex.zh: 暴風雨打亂了公司的供應鏈。

ex.en: A fuel surcharge will apply to all deliveries.
ex.zh: 所有配送都會收取燃料附加費。

ex.en: The airline added a surcharge for oversized cargo.
ex.zh: 航空公司對超大型貨物加收附加費。

ex.en: The surveyor marked the boundaries of the site.
ex.zh: 測量員標出了工地的界線。

ex.en: A surveyor inspected the land before construction began.
ex.zh: 施工開始前，測量師檢查了這塊土地。

ex.en: The tenant asked permission to sublet the apartment for the summer.
ex.zh: 房客詢問是否可以在夏季轉租公寓。

ex.en: You cannot sublet the office without written approval.
ex.zh: 未經書面核准，不得轉租辦公室。

ex.en: The firm opened a suburban branch to serve local families.
ex.zh: 公司在郊區設立分店，服務當地家庭。

ex.en: Suburban housing is often farther from major transit lines.
ex.zh: 郊區住宅通常離主要大眾運輸路線較遠。

ex.en: Will you please help me carry this suitcase?
ex.zh: 你能幫我拿這個行李箱嗎？

ex.en: What's the weight of your suitcase?
ex.zh: 你的行李箱有多重？

ex.en: I put my suitcase in the trunk.
ex.zh: 我把行李箱放進後車廂了。

ex.en: It is cheap to take the subway in Beijing.
ex.zh: 在北京搭地鐵很便宜。

ex.en: Excuse me, which subway line is to the city centre?
ex.zh: 不好意思，請問哪條地鐵線到市中心？

ex.en: Dad takes the 7 a.m. subway to work.
ex.zh: 爸爸搭早上 7 點的地鐵去上班。

ex.en: Demand for occupational therapy has surged in recent years.
ex.zh: 近年來職能治療的需求大幅增加。

ex.en: Due to the rainstorm, the river water surged over the river banks.
ex.zh: 暴雨讓河水暴漲，漫過了河岸。

ex.en: There was a surge in demand for masks.
ex.zh: 口罩需求激增。

ex.en: We expect a surge of visitors during the holidays.
ex.zh: 我們預期假期會湧入大量遊客。

ex.en: The following is a summary of the President's speech.
ex.zh: 以下是總統演講的摘要。

ex.en: Please write a short summary of the meeting.
ex.zh: 請寫一份簡短的會議摘要。

ex.en: We want to develop a new supply chain with a supplier from Algeria.
ex.zh: 我們想和一家阿爾及利亞的供應商建立新的供應鏈。

ex.en: We are looking for a cheaper supplier.
ex.zh: 我們正在找更便宜的供應商。

ex.en: I need to ask my supervisor before I can approve this.
ex.zh: 我得先問過主管才能核准這件事。

ex.en: Her supervisor praised her for finishing the project early.
ex.zh: 她的主管稱讚她提早完成了專案。

ex.en: A good manager listens to his subordinates.
ex.zh: 好主管會傾聽部屬的意見。

ex.en: She treats her subordinates with respect.
ex.zh: 她很尊重她的下屬。

ex.en: Personal interests should be subordinate to the team's goals.
ex.zh: 個人利益應該放在團隊目標之後。

ex.en: This issue is subordinate to the main problem.
ex.zh: 這個問題比主要問題次要。

ex.en: What subject do you think he is interested in?
ex.zh: 你覺得他會對什麼主題感興趣？

ex.en: I avoid discussing personal subjects with my boss.
ex.zh: 我避免跟老闆討論個人話題。

ex.en: The first subject that attracted my attention was philosophy.
ex.zh: 第一個吸引我注意的科目是哲學。

ex.en: He won the prize for excellence in all subjects.
ex.zh: 他因為各科成績優異而得獎。

ex.en: Please write a clear subject line for your email.
ex.zh: 請在電子郵件寫上清楚的主旨。

ex.en: The subject of the email was "Meeting Update."
ex.zh: 那封電子郵件的主旨是「會議更新」。

subject.zh: be subject to：容易受到…；須經…

ex.en: The tomato is subject to a number of diseases.
ex.zh: 番茄容易染上很多種病害。

ex.en: All prices are subject to change.
ex.zh: 所有價格可能隨時調整。
